name: desktop-continuity
description: Records Codex desktop activity through lifecycle hooks so Claude Desktop or Claude Code can continue an interrupted task, on this computer or another one.

interface.longDescription: Lifecycle hooks append a redacted, size-bounded event per prompt, tool call, tool result and turn end to this plugin's data folder. Claude Desktop and Claude Code read it through a separate read-only MCP server, and the skill exports a handoff for Session Capsule.
defaultPrompt: Export this task so I can continue it on another computer.
Show what desktop-continuity recorded for this session.
